title: Associate Legal Counsel, Japan

metadata.name: Is this job part of ACC?

descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join: 

Airbnb’s Legal team embodies the company’s innovative, forward-thinking spirit. At the frontier of the sharing economy, Airbnb is breaking new ground in matters of policy, law, and government relations. Where some see obstacles, we see the opportunity to find creative, practical solutions, right at the cutting edge. Our adventurous, fast-moving legal team is committed to building a team of talented, collaborative and self-motivated legal professionals across the globe who believe in Airbnb’s mission and leading as a 21st century company.

 

The Difference You Will Make:

We are in search of an Associate Legal Counsel for Japan.This role reports to the Associate General Counsel - Northeast Asia and serves as legal partner to many other teams outside Legal. Collaboration will be a key attribute as this role will work very closely with the other members of the legal team both in the region and globally. 

This role needs to be based in Japan. Any location in Japan is welcomed. Living in Tokyo or the greater Kanto area, with the ability to commute to the Tokyo office, is a plus. Candidates based elsewhere in Japan will need to travel to the Tokyo office roughly once or twice a month, as needed.

 

A Typical Day: 

  • Act as an effective and trusted partner to the fast-paced and high-performing Airbnb team. 
  • Deliver clear, effective and practical legal advice to the various business functions. These include business development, public policy, marketing and communications.  
  • Legal advice includes regulatory matters, consumer protection, competition, marketing, employment, privacy, dispute resolution, and law enforcement. 
  • Be adept in making sensible legal risk assessments which consider practical solutions to mitigate legal risk whilst keeping business priorities at the forefront.

 

Your Expertise:

  • Qualification in Japan (as bengoshi) is a must. 
  • Native-level command of Japanese (written and spoken) is a must.
  • Business-level English (written and spoken) is essential. High scores in standardized tests (TOEIC/TOEFL) is a plus.
  • Minimum 2years post-qualification experience - In-house (including secondment from a law firm) in an MNC and/or start-up is a plus.
  • Consistently delivers creative, thoughtful and business-oriented results that appropriately balance growth and risk.
  • Tech-forward mindset with a proactive willingness to leverage AI tools to optimize legal productivity.
  • Team player, highly collaborative with excellent communication and listening skills. 
  • Proactive owner who takes initiative while navigating competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Empathetic, caring and humble.
  • Occasional travel may be required: domestic travel to the Tokyo office roughly once or twice a month for candidates based outside the Kanto area, and international travel typically once a year for a few days. We give full consideration to individual circumstances and family commitments

 

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

 

 

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Associate Principal, Procurement Innovation Supplier Programs

metadata.name: Is this job part of ACC?

descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join: 

  • The Procurement team at Airbnb manages the source-to-pay processes including Accounts Payable, Travel and Expense, and the Contingent Workforce program. Procurement Innovation is a pillar within Procurement overseeing procurement tools, processes, reporting, and AI. 
  • We are a collaborative, forward-thinking team that embraces an AI-first mindset — leveraging technology, automation, and data to simplify processes and unlock new efficiencies. Guided by Airbnb’s mission to create a world where anyone can belong, we focus on delivering value through curiosity, creativity, and integrity.
  • Your role will involve close collaboration with key cross-functional partners, including Finance Technology Group, Procurement Operation, Third-Party Security, and various other business units. Together, we will ensure the efficient management of our programs and create an environment of collaboration, innovation, and inclusivity. 
  • Our focus on robust onboarding, monitoring, and promoting a great supplier experience will be at the forefront of everything you do. Join us and be part of a team that is making a positive impact in the world of procurement.

The Difference You Will Make:

  • In this exciting role, you will have responsibility to manage the supplier onboarding process, including the management of the tools, orchestration, and support the cross-function teams involved in onboarding operations to smoothly onboard third-party suppliers into the Airbnb financial system
  • You will also provide in-depth knowledge and optimization of supplier programs at Airbnb including maintaining effective supplier risk oversight measures, and establishing critical supplier programs in tandem with our Sourcing team.
  • In this role, we will measure your impact by developing process improvement recommendations based on your deep understanding of current procurement practices. You will enhance the supplier experience by executing transformational initiatives, aligning it with stakeholders' business needs while mitigating risk for Airbnb.

A Typical Day: 

  • Oversee and maintain supplier onboarding programs, ensuring the process meets the business and commercial needs of the organization.
  • Enrich the supplier experience by executing transformational initiatives that anticipate emerging supplier needs and deliver innovative solutions, aligning with stakeholders' business needs while mitigating risk for Airbnb.
  • Monitor supplier compliance to document operational health and improvements; communicate progress, barriers, risks, and benefits to appropriate business and management levels.
  • Collaborate with various teams to understand the requirements of the supplier risk management program and identify opportunities for system and operational enhancements. 
  • Manage project execution and tool implementation, providing detailed subject matter advice in the development of deliverables.
  • Provide expertise in the areas of source-to-pay, supplier risk management, regulatory assessment, procurement technology, and overall procurement transformation functions.

Your Expertise:

  • Degree or advanced degree in business, finance, supply chain or related fields.
  • 8+ years of experience managing procurement programs and/or leading preferred supplier programs
  • Experience managing supplier onboarding and risk management tools and processes, with expertise in implementing enterprise-wide systems.
  • Experience using data, automation, or AI tools to support decision-making.
  • Skilled in building relationships in a cross-functional environment and proven success in influencing stakeholders at all levels.
  • Highly analytical, with strong problem-solving skills and a data-driven approach to decision-making.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, both written and oral, with the ability to influence up, down, and across the organization.
  • Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple tasks efficiently with minimal supervision.

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list  If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process. 

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.  

Pay Range
$102,000—$120,000 USD

 

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Business Development Manager

metadata.name: Is this job part of ACC?

descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You'll Join

The Homes team plays a key role in shaping the Airbnb stays experience. As a multidisciplinary team, we partner with Hosts to build high-quality, repeatable, commercially viable offerings that reflect our brand values.

We're building something new: a dedicated Business Development function across EMEA, focused entirely on winning new professional supply for Airbnb. This isn't a role that inherits an existing book of business, it's a genuine new-business mandate, and you'll be one of the first people helping shape how we approach it.

For this role, you'll be at the forefront of expanding Airbnb's professional supply base in one of Europe's most important travel markets, reporting into our Homes EMEA team under the Field Operations Manager.

The Difference You'll Make

You're not managing what already exists, you're building what's next. You'll hunt down new opportunities, win new business, and bring high-quality professional hosts and partners onto Airbnb for the first time.

No inherited portfolio. No fixed playbook. Just a market to win, and the autonomy to figure out exactly how to win it.  You'll own the full deal, sourcing, pipeline, negotiation, signature, onboarding, and shape how Airbnb approaches new supply acquisition from the ground up.

What You'll Bring

  • Genuine new-business, hunter-style sales experience, not account management
  • A proven track record of personally sourcing, negotiating, and closing deals end-to-end
  • Comfort operating without an established playbook, and the drive to build your own approach
  • A self-directed, entrepreneurial mindset, you create opportunities rather than wait for them
  • Strong commercial instinct and the ability to think strategically about a market
  • Confidence taking full personal ownership of a deal, from first conversation to signed contract

A Typical Day: 

  • Prospect and onboard new, high quality professional hosts in your assigned territory, continuously building and managing a strong pipeline
  • Create and deploy scaled strategies to effectively acquire Professional Hosts in your region
  • Represent Airbnb in external meetings with Professional Hosts, showing up as a credible and knowledgeable market expert
  • Analyze data and utilize data-driven recommendations to identify and act on strategic opportunities in your region to drive sales growth
  • Develop deep knowledge of your assigned geographic markets across DACH
  • Build and manage partner relationships within your assigned territory
  • Maintain a baseline understanding of the technical integration of various software partners so that you can provide the right support to your clients
  • Educate clients on all significant product changes and cascade feedback on product and policy to relevant internal stakeholders
  • Respond to and deliver exceptional service to your professional hosts in a timely and efficient manner
  • Work cross-functionally with product, communications, public policy and customer support teams to ensure our long-term market success

Your Expertise:

  • 6+ years of experience in  sales 
  • 2+ years of hospitality/travel industry experience (nice to have)
  • Strong time management and prioritization skills
  • Strong B2B sales/new business development experience
  • Ability to work at both strategic and tactical levels, with a proven track record to execute in ambiguous environments
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to communicate effectively with clients
  • Experience building and strengthening relationships with external partners
  • Comfortable performing data analysis and making decisions based on the results
  • Available to travel to assigned markets
  • Ability to work within tight deadlines, adjust to changes in priorities, and balance short-term needs with long-term strategic initiatives
  • Hospitality/travel industry experience in the region is a plus
  • Highly proficient in using CRM software - Salesforce experience is a plus
  • Charismatic self-starter who is resourceful and self-sufficient
  • Fluency in German and English

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.
